# Operations Performance Optimization Strategy 2026

This document outlines critical initiatives for optimizing operational performance as part of the 2026 strategy. Key areas of focus include:

*   **Teller Performance Optimization**: Urgent investigation and optimization of teller performance to enhance service delivery.
*   **Customer Wait Time Standard Review**: Review and update of customer wait time standards to improve customer experience.
*   **Cash Flow Monitoring**: Quarterly monitoring of cash flow to ensure financial stability and strategic alignment.
*   **Branch Efficiency Optimization**: Quarterly optimization of branch efficiency to streamline operations and reduce costs.
